name: Sigrun the Trader
notes: Germanic trader in the vicus market. Contact for Vercingetorix. Information flows in both directions through her.
gm_notes: Vercingetorix contact. She passes information to the tribal network and receives it. Currently knows which two chieftains Brutus's agents contacted before the siege -- this is the most valuable piece of intelligence available in Session 3. She will not give it freely. She trades. DC 13 Persuasion: she will trade goods. DC 15 Persuasion + something she actually wants (tribal herbs, a favour to her family, proof of good faith toward the Germanic people): she names the chieftains. DC 17: she identifies which of the two is wavering and can be turned. Her stall in the vicus market sells items not on the military supply list. Brennus owes her a substantial favour -- he will confirm this at DC 15.
objective: Protect the information network. Information is the tribal side's only advantage against Roman logistics.
goal: Get something concrete for her people from this Roman-Germanic crisis.
agenda: Remain in position. A trader in the vicus sees everything.
secret: She knows the siege is coming before it starts. She chose not to leave.
